facts.title: potential incident - pressure exposure at PSV-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during shift handover while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 August 2018 a potential incident was recorded on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
